purpose: Test one predefined change: allocate 50% of available simulated cash on each trend entry instead of 100%.
prior_result_known: Full base return +397.69%, drawdown 52.27%; failed 35% research drawdown screen.
data_reuse: All historical periods were already examined in experiment 001. This is a diagnostic follow-up, not an unseen holdout, independent replication or proof of an edge.
allocation_semantics: At entry, spend the specified fraction of available cash inclusive of entry fees; leave the rest idle at zero yield. No rebalancing while holding. Weight may rise above 50% as price rises: this is not a continuous exposure cap.
benchmark: Buy and hold with 50% initial allocation, remaining cash idle, same friction; also retain the original 100% buy-and-hold benchmark. Same entry allocation is not matched volatility or matched risk.
signal_rules: Unchanged SMA200 and prior High20 entry; exit below SMA200 or prior Low10. Next-open fills, terminal-close liquidation with costs.
costs: Exactly the four original fee/slippage assumptions; USD120/year external operating sensitivity, not an actual bill; tax excluded.
windows: Exactly the original full, early, validation and recent chronological windows. Reset to USD10000 and flat for each window.

screen.note: Passing means historical risk/return candidate only. It cannot authorize live trading or establish profitability on unseen data. Recent profitability and comparison with both benchmarks must be reported even if unfavorable.

stop_condition: Run only 100% and 50%; do not search more fractions or alter signals based on this result.
prospective_next_step: If useful, freeze a forward paper-observation specification on new completed days after 2026-10-16. No claiming future observations today, no autonomous orders or paid services.
